title: Unary polynomial output with a space bound
statement: For every $C,e\in\mathbb{N}$, there exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every input $x$, $M$ outputs a string of $C(|x|+1)^e$ true bits within $c(|x|+1)^{e+1}$ steps. For every $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work space used through step $t$ is at most $c(|x|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: C and e are natural numbers
a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine and natural constant exist
output consists of C(|x|+1)^e true bits
space bound c(|x|+1) for every input and every t
